description: A short-range plan for a transit operator: how the service performs now, what riders and non-riders need, and what the network should look like within the next few years.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the notice-to-proceed date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.
It assumes an operator with existing service and recorded ridership. A plan that establishes a first service needs a feasibility study ahead of this one.
Service changes usually carry their own public notice and equity review obligations. Those differ by operator and by funder, and none are stated here.

No jurisdiction is assumed. Review periods, required notices, hearings and the body that adopts the work are set where you are; none of them are stated here. Add the records your own process requires.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Work plan and data request
deliverables.summary: The task list, the schedule, and the ridership, cost and operations data the analysis depends on.

deliverables.title: Existing service, fleet and facilities inventory
deliverables.summary: Routes, spans, frequencies, vehicles, stops and facilities as they actually operate today.

deliverables.title: Performance and market analysis
deliverables.summary: Ridership and productivity by route and time of day, set against where people live, work and need to travel.

deliverables.title: Rider and community survey summary
deliverables.summary: What riders and non-riders say about span, frequency, reliability, fares and access to stops.

deliverables.title: Service alternatives and resource implications
deliverables.summary: Network options with the vehicles, operators and facilities each would require, stated as resources rather than as a budget.

deliverables.title: Draft transit development plan
deliverables.summary: The complete draft, including the recommended network and its phasing.

deliverables.title: Final transit development plan
deliverables.summary: The draft revised after public and board review.

milestones.title: Project kickoff meeting
milestones.summary: Scope, data access and operator staff involvement confirmed.

milestones.title: Operations and driver workshop
milestones.summary: The people who run the service describe what the data cannot show.

milestones.title: Board study session on alternatives
milestones.summary: The governing board sees the options before the draft commits to one.

milestones.title: Public hearing on the recommended network
milestones.summary: The formal opportunity for riders to respond to proposed changes.

milestones.title: Board adoption of the plan
milestones.summary: Adoption by the transit board or governing body.
